name: Title_Run
evidence: Title screen (Mobile System GB logo, then title menu Start / mobile settings): A=0 on the first call plays the logo states, A!=0 starts at the title; runs Title_StateLoop, saves wRam_C27D to SRAM 1:$BF00, returns A=C27D+1 to 1C:4007

name: Title_StateLoop
evidence: Per-frame loop: Joypad_Update (7D:7BB7) poll, Title_DispatchState, 00:0956 sprite update, 00:044B wait VBlank; ends when state byte wRam_C27C==$FF, then clears LCDC bit2 (8x8 sprites)

name: Title_DispatchState
evidence: Jump-table dispatch on state wRam_C27C through Table_Title_States (jp hl); states 0-6

name: Table_Title_States
evidence: 7 word pointers, one per title state: logo load, logo wait, logo fade-out, title load, title menu, exit, timeout restart (6/7 targets executed)

name: Title_StateLoadLogo
evidence: State 0: Title_LoadLogoScreen (Mobile System GB logo), palette fade 4F:42FF, plays sound id $1B via stub 00:20E8, clears frame counter wRam_C27E/F, state++; screen = 'MOBILE SYSTEM GB' logo at frame 327-476 of every trace

name: Title_StateLogoWait
evidence: State 1: counts wRam_C27E/F up to 180 frames ($00B4) then state++; A or Start (hJoyPressedRepeat bit0/bit3) fades 4F:4370 and skips to state 3

name: Title_StateLogoFadeOut
evidence: State 2: palette fade via 4F:43B8, state++

name: Title_StateLoadTitle
evidence: State 3: reads last selection from SRAM bank 1 $BF00 into wRam_C27D, Title_LoadTitleScreen, fade-in 4F:42B4, plays sound id 1 (title music) via 00:20E8, clears frame counter, state++

name: Title_StateMenu
evidence: State 4: title menu; unless wRam_C280!=0 the idle timer wRam_C27E/F counts to $2A30 (10800 frames) then state 6; Up/Down toggle selection, A/Start confirm (state 5)

name: Title_MenuHandleButtons
evidence: State 4 button test on hJoyPressedRepeat: A (bit0) or Start (bit3) -> Title_MenuConfirm, Up (bit6) or Down (bit7) -> Title_MenuToggleSelection, else return

name: Title_MenuTimeout
evidence: Idle timer reached $2A30: sets state 6 (Title_StateTimeoutRestart); not executed in any trace

name: Title_MenuToggleSelection
evidence: Up/Down pressed: resets the idle timer wRam_C27E/F, plays sound id $29 (stub 00:20AC), toggles wRam_C27D (xor 1), redraws highlight (Title_DrawMenuHighlight) and cursor sprite (Title_PlaceCursor)

name: Title_MenuConfirm
evidence: A/Start pressed: plays sound id $2C via stub 00:20AC, state++ (state 5)

name: Title_StateExit
evidence: State 5: fade out 4F:4370 and sets state $FF, ending Title_StateLoop (Title_Run then stores/returns the selection)

name: Title_StateTimeoutRestart
evidence: State 6 (entered only by Title_MenuTimeout): fade out 4F:4370 and state:=0 so the logo sequence restarts; never executed

name: Title_LoadTitleScreen
evidence: Loads the title screen: HDMA of 7 tile blocks (Gfx_Title_*), palettes to $D800/$D840, tilemap 5BC0 to $D000, two sprite objects (5FB0), highlight plate and cursor; called by Title_StateLoadTitle

name: Title_DrawMenuHighlight
evidence: Copies the 4x10 highlight tilemap (bc=$040A) of the selected item from Table_Title_HighlightTilemaps[wRam_C27D] to the tile buffer at $D185 (00:08EA)

name: Table_Title_HighlightTilemaps
evidence: 2 word pointers (5E90, 5EE0) to the 4x10 tile+attr highlight plates for menu item 0 / 1; read as data by Title_DrawMenuHighlight

name: Title_PlaceCursor
evidence: Moves sprite slot $DA10 (00:0A65) to the position of the selected item taken from Table_Title_CursorPositions[wRam_C27D]

name: Table_Title_CursorPositions
evidence: 2 x (x,y) pairs $18,$60 and $18,$70: cursor sprite position for title item 0 and 1; read by Title_PlaceCursor

name: Title_LoadLogoScreen
evidence: Loads the Mobile System GB logo screen: HDMA tiles 60A0/64A0, palette 6B70, tilemap 68A0; called by the first title state (first at frame 327; 35 of 41 scenarios)

name: Gfx_Title_Tiles0
evidence: Title tile block 0, 64 tiles HDMA'd to VRAM $8000 bank 0 by Title_LoadTitleScreen

name: Gfx_Title_Tiles1
evidence: Title tile block 1, 64 tiles to VRAM $8800 bank 0; its second half is also the source of the bank-1 upload from $49C0

name: Gfx_Title_Tiles2
evidence: Title tile data: second half of the 1 KB read from $49C0 (-> VRAM $8001, vbank 1) and first half of the 1 KB read from $4BC0 (-> $8801, vbank 1) by Title_LoadTitleScreen

name: Gfx_Title_Tiles3
evidence: Title tile data: second half of the 1 KB read from $4BC0 (-> VRAM $8801, vbank 1); read only by that upload

name: Gfx_Title_Tiles4
evidence: Title tile block, 64 tiles to VRAM $8C00 bank 1

name: Gfx_Title_Tiles5
evidence: Title tile block, 64 tiles to VRAM $9000 bank 1

name: Gfx_Title_Tiles6
evidence: Title tile block, 64 tiles to VRAM $9400 bank 1

name: Tilemap_Title_Screen
evidence: Title screen 20x18 tile map + attribute map (bc=$1214, 720 bytes) copied to $D000 by 00:08EA in Title_LoadTitleScreen

name: Tilemap_Title_HighlightStart
evidence: 4x10 tile+attr plate (80 bytes) for item 0 (Start); first word of Table_Title_HighlightTilemaps

name: Tilemap_Title_HighlightSettings
evidence: 4x10 tile+attr plate (80 bytes) for item 1 (mobile settings); second word of Table_Title_HighlightTilemaps

name: Palette_Title_Bg
evidence: 64-byte BG palette block copied to $D800 (4F:4000, bc=$0040) by Title_LoadTitleScreen

name: Palette_Title_Obj
evidence: 64-byte OBJ palette block copied to $D840 by Title_LoadTitleScreen

name: Objects_Title
evidence: Sprite object table + records of the title screen: 00:0A82 loads entries $81 (slot $DA10) and $82 (slot $DA20) from de=$5FB0

name: Gfx_TitleLogo_Tiles0
evidence: Mobile System GB logo tiles, 64 tiles to VRAM $9000 bank 1 (Title_LoadLogoScreen)

name: Gfx_TitleLogo_Tiles1
evidence: Mobile System GB logo tiles, 64 tiles to VRAM $9400 bank 1 (Title_LoadLogoScreen)

name: Tilemap_TitleLogo_Screen
evidence: Logo screen 20x18 tile+attr map (720 bytes) copied to $D000 by Title_LoadLogoScreen

name: Palette_TitleLogo
evidence: 64-byte BG palette copied to $D800 by Title_LoadLogoScreen
